objective: Build and validate a provenance-preserving evidence retrieval and RAG layer connecting the validated Alzheimer Evidence Foundation, Evidence Fabric, Knowledge Graph and controlled local LLM runtime.

substeps.name: RETRIEVAL_ARCHITECTURE_AND_CONTRACT
substeps.purpose: Define controlled retrieval inputs, outputs, ranking, provenance and safety boundaries.

substeps.name: EVIDENCE_DOCUMENT_NORMALIZATION
substeps.purpose: Convert validated Evidence Fabric records into deterministic retrieval documents.

substeps.name: CONTROLLED_RETRIEVAL_INDEX
substeps.purpose: Create a reproducible local retrieval index from validated project evidence.

substeps.name: EVIDENCE_RETRIEVAL_FUNCTION
substeps.purpose: Implement deterministic evidence retrieval with explicit query and result contracts.

substeps.name: PROVENANCE_PRESERVING_RETRIEVAL
substeps.purpose: Ensure every retrieved item retains source, identifier, citation and provenance.

substeps.name: EVIDENCE_GROUNDED_RAG_PROMPT
substeps.purpose: Connect retrieved evidence to the validated Phase 22 grounding contract.

substeps.name: LANGGRAPH_RETRIEVAL_LLM_WORKFLOW
substeps.purpose: Integrate retrieval and controlled local LLM execution into the stateful workflow.

substeps.name: RETRIEVAL_AND_GROUNDING_EVALUATION
substeps.purpose: Evaluate retrieval relevance, provenance, grounding and evidence coverage.

substeps.name: LANGSMITH_RAG_TRACING
substeps.purpose: Trace retrieval, context construction and controlled model execution.

substeps.name: PHASE_23_END_TO_END_VALIDATION
substeps.purpose: Validate all Phase 23 controls, artifacts, traceability and safety boundaries.

retrieval_rules: Only validated project evidence may enter the controlled retrieval corpus.
Every retrieved record must retain provenance.
Every retrieved record must retain its source identifier.
Unsupported evidence must not be silently introduced.
Missing evidence must remain explicitly missing.
Observation and inference must remain separate.
rag_rules: Retrieved evidence must be explicitly separated from model-generated text.
The model must not treat absence of retrieved evidence as evidence of absence.
The model must not invent citations.
The model must not generate unsupported scientific claims.
Evidence provenance must survive the complete workflow.
completion_requirement: Phase 23 may be marked COMPLETE only after substeps 23.1 through 23.10 are individually validated and all required artifacts are saved to persistent Google Drive storage.
